remarks:
Tucked within a quiet stretch of Buffalo’s East Side, the Peckham Street assemblage offers a rare opportunity to shape nearly an acre of land into something meaningful and enduring. With 9 parcels on both sides of the street, the site lends itself to thoughtful infill development, community-minded design, and creative uses that bring life back to underutilized space. Imagine new homes rising where vacant land once stood, garden beds and green spaces softening the streetscape, and shared outdoor areas that encourage neighbors to gather and connect. Whether envisioned as a cluster of new residences, a mixed use community space, or a carefully planned block revitalization project, the Peckham Street lots present the scale and flexibility that developers and visionaries look for when transforming land into lasting value.


The Peckham Street assemblage includes multiple parcels across both sides of the street totaling approximately 0.9144 acres. On the first side, the lots at 59, 69, 71, and 75 Peckham Street total approximately 0.60 acres, including 59 Peckham at 0.30 acres, 69 and 71 Peckham at 0.074 acres each, and 75 Peckham at approximately 0.151 acres. On the opposite side, the parcels at 88, 92, 94, 96 and 98 Peckham Street total approximately 0.3144 acres, with individual lot sizes of 0.074, 0.068, 0.068, and 0.0716 acres respectively. Funding and grants for new construction could be available through programs such as New York State Homes and Community Renewal, HOME dollars, and other local initiatives, which may help support buyer interest and overall value.

This property can also be purchased as part of a larger assemblage including a 27,806 sq feet church at 300 Adams (MLS#B1665688) with school on .52 acres (MLS#B1665930), the parsonage duplex at 308 Adams Street (MLS#B1665682), and three additional vacant lot listings within one block (MLS#B1665990, MLS#B1666038, MLS#B1666042). The combined properties offer expanded development potential and flexibility for a larger project footprint. Equal Housing Opportunity!
